ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of the Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the Trump administration's freeze on child care funding, including the effects on low-income families and the economy as a whole.
questions: What are the motivations behind the funding freeze?
How will this freeze impact low-income families?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue affecting low-income families and the economy. By following the money and analyzing the data, we may be able to uncover a larger pattern of federal funding freezes and their consequences.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Truth Behind the Federal Reserve Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the criminal investigation into Jerome Powell, including the potential motivations and consequences.
questions: What are the allegations against Jerome Powell?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue affecting the economy and the independence of the Federal Reserve. By analyzing public records and speaking with whistleblowers, we may be able to uncover a larger pattern of corruption or abuse of power.
